layout.hierarchy: Title 'Precision' dominates in large bold red. The formula box and confusion matrices are secondary focal points. The tree diagram illustrates the numbers visually. The blue question box at the bottom acts as a concluding prompt.

visual_elements.description: 2x2 confusion matrix. Column header 'Predicted as' spanning P and N. Row header 'Actual' with rows P and N. Cells contain TP, FN, FP, TN. Cell backgrounds appear color-tinted (TP reddish, FN/FP yellowish, TN greenish).
2x2 confusion matrix with same P/N structure. Cells contain 18, 12, 10, 60. The 18 cell is enclosed in a blue/purple rounded highlight; the 60 cell is enclosed in a green rounded highlight.

Two separate branch diagrams. Left: label 'Positive' with airplane icon above a red circle '30'; arrows branch down to red circle '18' labeled TP and gold circle '12' labeled FN. Right: label 'Negative' with airplane icon above a green circle '70'; arrows branch down to green circle '60' labeled TN and red circle '10' labeled FP.
Light blue rectangular box with darker blue border containing the question about trusting a positive classification.
Two cream/light-green callout boxes with arrows pointing to TP and FP in the formula, labeled 'Positive Classified as +ive' and 'Negative Classified as +ive'.

imagery: Two small airplane icons at the top of the Positive and Negative tree diagrams, stylized line-art style
Small yellow shape in extreme top-right corner, possibly a page corner or logo watermark
typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout. Title is very large, bold, red. Section headers like 'Meaning' are bold red. Key terms like 'Predicted', 'POSITIVE', 'Positive', 'Negative' are bold or colored. The two definition lines under the title are underlined. Formula uses a horizontal fraction bar. Matrix headers are small bold text. Node numbers in the tree are white bold text inside colored circles.
animation_state: None; slide appears fully built with all elements visible simultaneously.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to white. 2. Add title text 'Precision' at top left-center in large bold red sans-serif (~40pt). 3. Below title, add two underlined black lines: 'Correctly Classified (as Positive)' and 'Total Classified as Positive (either Correct and Erroneous)'. 4. On the left-middle, add red bold header 'Meaning', then the sentence '% of what you Predicted as POSITIVE is Actually Positive' with 'Predicted' and 'POSITIVE' in bold red. 5. Draw a rectangular formula box with a horizontal line; place 'Precision' on the left and 'TP / (TP + FP)' on the right of the line. 6. To the right of the formula box, add 'Precision= 18/(18+10) =64.3%'. 7. Add two cream callout boxes with arrows: 'Positive Classified as +ive' pointing to TP, and 'Negative Classified as +ive' pointing to FP. 8. Top-right: build a 2x2 table with 'Predicted as' header over columns P and N, 'Actual' label beside rows P and N; fill cells with TP, FN, FP, TN and tint backgrounds (TP red-ish, FN/FP gold-ish, TN green-ish). 9. Middle-right: build an identical 2x2 table with cells 18, 12, 10, 60; add a blue rounded highlight around 18 and a green rounded highlight around 60. 10. Bottom-right: draw two flowchart trees. Left tree labeled 'Positive' with airplane icon, red circle '30' at top, arrows to red circle '18' (TP) and gold circle '12' (FN). Right tree labeled 'Negative' with airplane icon, green circle '70' at top, arrows to green circle '60' (TN) and red circle '10' (FP). 11. Bottom-left: add red text 'All Samples classified as Positive'. 12. Bottom-center: add a light blue box with dark blue border containing 'If you said: the sample is positive, can I trust you ? At what %?'.
